description: Delete an index. Item data is untouched, but ordering, filtering, searching and alias lookups that used it stop working. Deleting a guard index makes its values readable by every token that can read the list, so that's refused unless confirmUnguard is true. 1 request (plus 1 to check for a guard, if the list hasn't been read with get_list).

confirmUnguard.description: Confirm deleting a guard index, which un-hides its values

index.description: The index: its id or pathName

list.description: The list: its id or pathName

name: delete_index
title: Delete an index
